intro: Google Sheets is the primary workspace for most SEO analysts working on a Mac. It is a powerful tool for managing keyword lists, technical audit data, and client reporting. Because it runs in your browser, you can access your data from any machine. This guide covers how to use Google Sheets more effectively on your Mac and how to use Lazur to handle the repetitive parts of your workflow.

blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets on your Mac

Google Sheets does not have a native Mac app. It lives in your browser. For the best experience, use Google Chrome. You can make it feel like a desktop app by using the Progressive Web App feature. Open sheets.google.com in Chrome. Click the three-dot menu in the top right corner. Select Cast, Save, and Share, then click Install page as app. This creates a shortcut in your Applications folder and keeps your spreadsheet in its own window.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for SEO analysts
Speed matters when you are auditing thousands of rows. Stop using your mouse for everything. Press ⌘ + / to see every available shortcut. Here are the ones you will use most often.

SEO audits often involve massive exports from tools like Screaming Frog or Ahrefs. Google Sheets allows up to 20 million cells per sheet. If your file starts to lag, check for complex formulas across the entire sheet. Move static data to a separate tab. Use the filter feature to view only what you need. If you are struggling with a formula, ask Lazur to explain how to fix it.
Lazur helps you work faster by answering questions about your screen. Hold ⌥ + ⌘ to ask about a formula or a menu item. Lazur circles the button you need and tells you what to do next.
If you are stuck on a VLOOKUP or a complex regex, hold ⌥ + ⌘ and ask Lazur for the correct syntax. It will explain the formula so you can learn it for next time.
blocks.title: Get formula help

blocks.text: Many analysts lose time because of simple errors. Always check your data range before running a formula. Avoid merging cells, as this breaks sorting and filtering. Use the freeze row feature to keep your headers visible while scrolling through long keyword lists. If you share your sheet, ensure you set permissions to view only so your data stays clean.

SEO work involves a lot of repetitive tasks. Use Macros to record your actions. Go to Extensions > Macros > Record macro. Perform your steps like formatting a report or cleaning up a CSV. Save the macro and assign a shortcut. You can then run this with a single key combination.

faq.question: Is there an official Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, there is no official native Mac app. You should use Google Chrome and install the site as a Progressive Web App for a better experience.

faq.question: How many cells can I have in a Google Sheet?
faq.answer: As of September 2026, the limit is 20 million cells per spreadsheet.

faq.question: How can I see all keyboard shortcuts in Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + / inside any Google Sheet to open the complete list of keyboard shortcuts.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my Google Sheets files for me?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It points at items, explains steps, and helps you work faster by answering your questions.
